description: Activate the cadence of ONE draft campaign. Fills the campaign's cadence template with each person's name, company, role and signals into its steps (by default a LinkedIn connection and message first, then e-mail, alternating) to go out through the selected connected Gmail, LinkedIn and/or WhatsApp accounts. When several accounts are connected on a channel, the account id for that channel is required. A reply stops the person's remaining steps. Activating here does not turn on automatic sending: unless the campaign already has the owner's authorization, every message waits for approval in the Inbox, and "Aprovar antes de enviar" is saved on. Automatic sending is an authorization given only in the campaign's Settings screen, by the workspace's owner or an admin. The result says which applies (automaticSending; when false, approval and settingsUrl, the link to that screen). A campaign already authorized can send immediately inside the business window. When the campaign has people whose messages come from an earlier version of the template (messagesOutdated), activating first writes those people's messages again and then activates; rewrittenBeforeActivation in the result reports it. When people of the campaign still wait on their sheet row's e-mail, LinkedIn or phone lookup, enrichmentPending counts them by field and enrichmentPendingNote is a short sentence saying so; the address joins the campaign by itself when the lookup finishes.

channels.description: Connected channels the user explicitly approved. Omit for a campaign of WhatsApp only: its steps are tasks the sender sends from their own phone, with no account to connect.

linkedinAccountId.description: Connected LinkedIn accountId, required when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

mailboxId.description: Connected Gmail mailbox UUID, required when several mailboxes are connected.

whatsappAccountId.description: Connected WhatsApp accountId, required when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.
